== 15 July 2005 forum typing, 25 November 2026 ==
A 15 July 2005 typing of the full set texts by CRingwell, in the Players Committee forum topic "Virtual Set 8" (t=6360), was added to [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]] from the Internet Archive capture of 18 June 2006. The card texts themselves were not copied onto the set page; the capture is cited as a source. This is the pre-2009 set, not the post-2014 [[Virtual Set 8]].
